metadata.description: Antarctic Digital Twin large simulated dataset - Bharati Station
metadata.notes: All records are simulated for hackathon/prototype use. Station identity/location fields are real (NCPOR). Temperature ranges are calibrated to published Bharati winter climatology (~-18C avg winter). No real historical sensor telemetry is publicly available for this station.
